messages:
mira: Alert — VentureWorks active sessions down ~50% last 7d after onboarding handoff. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/telemetry/vw (major dips on /chat and /embeddings).

tyler: Noticed the SSO flip on 2025-03-10 in the runbook. No final customer smoke-test recorded.

sanjay: AE here — procurement said they're seeing vendor demos next week. This is a near-term renewal risk.

anya: I can export token and route-level latency and seat activity. @mira confirm critical endpoints?

mira: Critical: `POST /v1/chat`, `POST /v1/embeddings`, and their custom rerank job.

tyler: Logs show auth failures and intermittent 502s ~2025-03-11T03:12Z, correlated with the SSO cutover.

elena: Customer: "Users had doubled latency and random 401s; some conversations dropped." On the thread now.

sanjay: Quick mitigations: 1) Emergency API-key fallback for a named svc account. 2) Offer 14-day burst pool to stabilize latency. 3) Exec sync Wed with procurement.

anya: I'll run cost delta and expected P95/P99 improvements by EOD and share CSV.

tyler: I'll rehearse a rollback in staging and prepare a canary for prod. Need tech contact approvals — @mira pls intro.

mira: Intro sent to Elena; uploaded logs and a short timeline to the shared folder.

incident-bot: Created INC-20250311-VW-AUTH for elevated auth errors.

sanjay: Owners: @tyler rollback/canary, @anya cost+SLA, @mira customer comms + exec brief. I'll draft ROI slides.

mira: If canary ok, we'll push temporary keys until SSO root cause fixed; prepping customer note now"
